specs.title: WCAG 2 A/AA checks pass on the model and detail surfaces
Create and Compose restart updates the actual GPU state
Compose retains real source geometry and does not rebuild on selection, rename or mode
corrupt image and saved composition fail safely
portrait cropping stays square on screen and supports re-upload after removal
every catalog model loads its full instance set
corrupt geometry is rejected by checksum and a retry recovers
all workspace surfaces have visible pixels and accessible controls at desktop sizes
mouse preview follows, stamps continuously, rotates, stacks, paints and undoes
dragging never places and collisions are rejected on a locked layer
assemblies are atomic, ground extends, persistence and file exports work
large projects remain batched and storage failures keep editing available
desktop screenshots contain geometry, thumbnails and accessible controls
real geometry, framing, views, motion, reversible explosion and pixel coverage
search, identity, same-type selection, isolation, visibility and source metadata
drag does not select and desktop layout has no horizontal overflow
missing geometry has an actionable error, not a blank canvas
reduced motion and credits dialog work with keyboard
every inventory instance is individually addressable
WebGL unavailable shows a fallback
lost WebGL context is recoverable
downloads contain actual data and changing layout preserves the inventory
slow network reports progress and reaches the complete model
catalog exposes fifteen projects, real previews and model parameters
landing showcase slowly builds and completes a full explode cycle
language toggle translates the complete workspace and persists
clicking a project card opens explore while the only command is build
additional project loads real geometry and supports search highlight and x-ray
desktop renderer uses high-density pixels and supports 4x ultra mode
build mode advances, animates and persists progress per project
build steps preserve the user camera unless follow mode is enabled
build canvas pans horizontally and vertically without moving the model base
step snapshots never resize or flash the live canvas and controls stay top-left
selected build brick opens an interactive geometry preview
build guide exports cover and one page per step
source-authored instruction model exposes OMR steps
editorial scene builds movable assemblies before final placement
complex train and truck models load all addressable bricks
large batched model expands completely without multiplying draw calls
workspace navigation returns home and switches models
creator preflights a local MPD without uploading it
composer snaps reusable models and parts into a buildable saved scene
image studio converts an image into bricks, steps, and exports
